text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder appears more upbeat<n>than before
as she exits the waiting<n>room, fully prepared to
race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Determined to walk her own path,<n>Grass Wonder
heads for the track,<n>where her formidable opponent
Special Week awaits.
